references.text: The immediate context describing that no one with a defect shall approach to offer God's bread, and introducing the list of physical defects that disqualify a priest.
Continuation of the list of physical defects that prevent a priest from serving at the altar, including other bodily imperfections.
Describes the requirement for sacrificial animals to have no defect, paralleling the requirement for the priests' physical perfection.
The Passover lamb was not to have any bone broken, pointing to the importance of physical wholeness in sacrificial service.
Reiterates that no bones shall be broken on the Passover offering, emphasizing the theme of physical integrity in holy service.
The fulfillment of the prophecy that none of the Messiah's bones would be broken, linking Christ to the perfect, unblemished sacrificial lamb.
